reviewMethod: All 20 selected stored files across five current-corpus articles were independently rehashed against the frozen read-only GitHub evidence artifact, checked for exact task/page/article/source DOI identity using stage binding plus report/index and DOI-bearing article/source URLs, original Figure/Scheme identity and independent caption, captureVersion 6.2.20, job identity, fixed media generation 1790082000000, content-addressed R2 key, actual byte length/type/dimensions, duplicate source/hash ownership and frozen public media-index state. SVG files were rendered and checked for active/external content; PNG files were decoded. Every image was visually reviewed against its caption and paper theme for role, unrelated/recommendation contamination, duplicate risk and legibility. Capture success/partial markers were treated only as provenance evidence. No publisher request, R2/D1 write, server-side direct import/repair, literature/card/title/scope mutation, userscript change or media-generation change was performed.
quality: The 20 files are exact stored bytes: seventeen self-contained SVGs and three decoded PNGs, all within configured size bounds and with unique selected content hashes. Frozen public media-index records contain no same-ID body figures for these five DOI; their existing official TOCs are distinct and preserved, so this packet is additive and body-only. JACS 10.1021/jacs.6c07049 has stored Figure 2 and Figure 6 from an earlier 2/7 partial attempt while the newest report is 0/7, and JACS 10.1021/jacs.6c08636 remains partial 1/7; only the exact stored files reviewed here are approved and missing figures are not inferred approved. Historical controller/transport failures are retained as provenance and are not attributed to VPN, R2, quota or another cause without evidence.
